title: Is AI an existential threat? The doom case and its counter-case
question: Do current arguments justify high confidence that advanced AI will cause human extinction or permanent disempowerment, and therefore justify drastic intervention now?
description: Seed argumentation fixture. The existential-risk position is stated in the strongest form its proponents use; the proportionate-risk position is the author's counter-case. Modalities record how strongly each side asserts a proposition, not the analyst's belief.
